blocks.body:
name = "acme/grading-script-models"
version = "1.0.0"
[verifier]
env = { OPENAI_API_KEY = "${OPENAI_API_KEY}", MODE = "x", K = "${ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL:-http://x}" }

diagnostics.message: verifier.env.OPENAI_API_KEY resolves ${OPENAI_API_KEY} from the host; a runtime resolves it only if the operator allows that variable, and never a provider key: a seat that calls a model gets the runtime's proxy and a scoped token instead

verifier.env.K resolves ${ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL} from the host; a runtime resolves it only if the operator allows that variable, and never a provider key: a seat that calls a model gets the runtime's proxy and a scoped token instead

grading calls a model from a script ([verifier] env names ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, OPENAI_API_KEY; verifier/test.sh runs RewardKit, whose judges call a model), but [verifier] models is not true: set [verifier] models = true, so the runtime gives the verifier a seat token and the proxy's URL. Without it the script cannot reach a model on a task.md runtime, and its judge calls fail
